title: They Alone Are Great, Who Are Lovingly
summary: Attachment is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:; they alone are great, who are lovingly attached to the Lord
lifeApplication: Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.shortMeaning: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:; they alone are great, who are lovingly attached to the Lord
source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.

evidence.coreClaim: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:; they alone are great, who are lovingly attached to the Lord
evidence.turn: Attachment steadies when without the Lord's meditation, there is no salvation.
